'''Alliance Cold Weather Backpack''' was a specialized [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] issued to the members of [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] during assignments in extremely frigid climates like [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] as part of their [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|cold-weather outfit]]. Its main and only purpose was to help protect the wearer from [[Hypothermia/Legends|hypothermia]] and the equipment it contained from freezing. It also contained survival gear such as a small heater and shelter.
